title: retail bank complaint handling: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 84 min of staff time per complaint, averaged

steps.task: Log the complaint from email, app, call notes or a branch form into the complaints system
Classify product, issue and severity; flag vulnerability; set the internal SLA date
Pull statements, card transactions, CRM history and call notes from four or five systems
Ask card operations or the branch for what the systems don't show, and chase the reply
Check the facts against product terms and the fee schedule; decide the outcome and redress
Draft the final response letter in Arabic or English from a template
Review the outcome and letter; sign off and send
Tag the root cause and compile the monthly regulatory complaints return
Handle the 5% escalated or referred to Sanadak (60 min each, averaged)

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 26 min of human time per complaint, averaged

steps.task: Pull every channel into one record; OCR branch forms; match the customer; remove duplicates
Extract product, issue, amounts, the remedy asked for and vulnerability signals; pick a lane
Start the internal SLA timer, send the acknowledgement, alert before any deadline is at risk
Query core banking, cards and CRM read-only; build a cited evidence pack. Simple lane: recommend
Standard and complex lanes: weigh evidence against terms and policy; recommend uphold or not
Confirm or change every outcome; code computes the redress from the fee schedule
Draft the final response letter in the customer's language; a Haiku verifier checks every figure
Sign off every letter; nothing reaches the customer before this
Tag the root cause on closure; code builds the monthly regulatory return for sign-off
